description: Pendulum with a custom red bob and thin rod, demonstrating style customization parameters.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_physics import *

class PendulumCustomBob(SpaceScene):
    def construct(self):
        p = Pendulum(
            length=3,
            initial_theta=0.5,
            rod_style={"stroke_width": 2, "color": GREY},
            bob_style={"radius": 0.2, "color": RED, "fill_opacity": 1},
        )
        self.add(p)
        self.make_rigid_body(*p.bobs)
        p.start_swinging()
        self.wait(2)
